svg.title: 规则约束下的模型适配与推理服务 · 监管审核模型微调、量化发布与 Skill 执行
svg.desc: qwen3.8-27b 面向监管语义、风险标签和结构化审核进行 LoRA / QLoRA 适配；AWQ / GPTQ 产物通过风险漏检、结构稳定性与显存延迟回归后部署到 vLLM / Docker。LangChain 连接私有推理端点，pi 执行独立版本的监管 Skill，Langfuse 关联审核记录与模型版本。；审核模型与任务样本：qwen3.8-27b，Base Weights / Tokenizer / Config；Regulatory Audit Dataset，Risk Labels / Missing Disclosures，Cross-material Conflicts / Schema，Business-split Holdout / Hard Negatives；领域语义与输出适配：Audit Task Fine-tuning，PyTorch / PEFT / LoRA / QLoRA，Domain Semantics / Structured Output，Adapter Merge / Checkpoint；量化校准与审核准入：AWQ / GPTQ Calibration，Audit Material Calibration Set，Quantized Weights / Kernel Config，GPU Memory / Inference Precision；Audit Model Release Gate，Risk Recall / False Negative Review，Element Accuracy / Schema Regression，Latency / Throughput / GPU Memory；私有推理部署：vLLM Audit Model Service，Docker / qwen3.8-27b，Quantized Weights / Model Version，Inference API / Batching / Capacity；监管 Skill 与应用执行：pi Audit Runtime，TypeScript / Node.js，Audit Context / Risk Report；LangChain Model Adapter，Python / FastAPI / Pydantic，Structured Output / Timeout / Budget；Regulatory Skill Registry，Versioned Regulatory Skills，Scenario Checks / Required Elements；Langfuse Audit Trace，Model / Skill / Parser Version，Risk Item / Trace / Sample Replay；01 qwen3.8-27b → Audit Task Fine-tuning：基础权重与分词配置；02 Regulatory Audit Dataset → Audit Task Fine-tuning：监管场景样本、正常反例与结构化结果；03 Audit Task Fine-tuning → AWQ / GPTQ Calibration：合并适配权重并校准量化；04 Audit Task Fine-tuning → Audit Model Release Gate：适配版本的审核质量基线；05 AWQ / GPTQ Calibration → Audit Model Release Gate：量化版本的漏检、结构与资源回归；06 Audit Model Release Gate → vLLM Audit Model Service：通过质量和资源检查的模型版本；07 pi Audit Runtime ↔ LangChain Model Adapter：审核语义核验请求 / 结构化模型结果；08 LangChain Model Adapter ↔ vLLM Audit Model Service：统一推理调用 / 风险与要素输出；09 Regulatory Skill Registry → pi Audit Runtime：独立装载监管 Skill 与审核口径；10 LangChain Model Adapter → Langfuse Audit Trace：模型版本、风险项与推理用量
